typesense:top-rated.greeting:
As you're ushered into the large doors of the facility, a robotic voice pings to life from a PA system:
Welcome to the Institute of human pet Transformation, where we Turn resistant humans into pathetic pets for their owners use. As you enter our premises, cast your gaze upon the human puppies, ponies, kittens, cows, and piggies engaged in their respective activities. Watch as these once-human subjects carry out their duties with unwavering devotion, their minds reprogrammed to embrace their new roles as living submissive companions.
Observe the puppies eagerly servicing their masters the ponies presenting their holes for mounting, the kittens arching their backs in anticipation of cream-filled rewards, the cows moaning as milk is extracted from their swollen udders, 
Now, as you contemplate your own role in this world of carnal delights, consider how you wish to proceed. Perhaps you've identified a suitable candidate from your personal life whom you'd like to see reduced to a pathetic, whimpering pet? Or you are looking for a pre-made pet to suit your lifestyle?
(If you'd like to be the pet being trained, just add that you've been brought here to be trained in your opening message)
